releaseNotes: Auto Puzzles now finishes Basement by using the owned key at the trapdoor after all three server-confirmed puzzles and EscapeReady. With puzzle Auto TP enabled, approaches the ladder from below the ceiling, equips the key and aims at the keyhole. Shares one hand-in engine with AutoWin to prevent duplicate requests, pauses farm/TNT/gems/buy/equip during exit, bounds retries and yields camera control to the game's ending scene. Waits for the key when missing and stops actions on actual round completion. Does not automatically return to the lobby; preserves the color clue solver and roaming farm.
